title: pm-dispatch(execution): an empty-queue report is a per-card table with live labels and a named blocker; a remainder under ui/ is dispatched, never skipped
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiHXKqxUqDPJKZyNHP7BoqTb)_

Fixes #28638
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:席位报「无卡可派」时必须逐卡列表(卡号、当轮现读的标签与 assignee、具名卡点),无具名卡点的卡就是候选,不得报「空」;余项落在 `ui/**` 的排队卡照常派发,不再当「UI 的」或「别的仓的」跳过。三个文件各改一两行,行数棘轮内付清。
- 为什么改:server 车道席位对着 7 张已定级、无人认领的卡报了「队列空」,只因每张卡剩下的一半是 UI;`ui/` 早已并入本仓,无任何外部阻塞。没有逐卡表,唯一的核对就是维护者亲手再跑一次查询。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` 规则文本,无代码、无门禁改动;风险是付行数时删掉的五行(各自主节仍载同一规则,PR 正文逐行列出处)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉新增三行(规则本体);② `references/execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉新增两行(`ui/**` 余项与「他车道项」的边界);③ 五处删行的出处对照(本正文 What changes)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint && pnpm check:skill-frame-sync && pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` 全绿;`wc -l` 三文件仍为 319 / 96 / 188。
- 需要你做的:Tier S(`.claude/**`):席位达档复核 PASS 后由席位落地;无需维护者动作。

## What changes

Scope is the three Wanted items of the card, text only, under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`.

**Item 1 — an empty-queue report is a per-card table** (`references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉, three lines after 「队列空是待命非退场」):

- 「队列空」is a per-card table, not a verdict: whoever hears "nothing to dispatch" (maintainer, coordinator, round report) gets every card the lane's queue filter returns at that moment.
- Per card: the number, the labels and assignee read in the same turn (never a cached reading), and a named blocker. A card with no named blocker is a candidate, and the report may not say "empty".
- One blocker vocabulary, not two: the inverse of the candidate definition in `execution-duties.md` (assigned, `needs-user-decision`, `pm:retriage`, the `tooling` exclusion), plus an open `Blocked-by:` line, a missing triage audit comment and a sibling seat's `Claim:`.
- `SKILL.md` L74 (the self-exit line) now points at that section — a net-zero edit, 120 bytes.

**Item 2 — a remainder under `ui/` is dispatched as normal** (`references/execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉, two lines right after the self-split pair):

- A queue card whose remaining work lands under `ui/**` is dispatched as normal: `ui/` is in this repo, so the same worktree, gates and merge queue apply; it is never skipped as "UI".

**Item 3 — reconciliation with the self-split line and the `domain:ui` lane row**, measured on `origin/main` at 706ac52d57:

- The lane table's `domain:ui` row does make `ui/**` a `domain:ui` surface — for *file ownership*. The same section says a `domain:*` label decides file ownership only and is never a queue unit (域车道 bullet 2), and the cross-boundary channels name "the claiming seat follows its own cross-boundary surface to the end" (域车道, 越界只四通道). `cross-repo-coordination.md` already ships a new spec key in the same PR as its first `ui/` reader. So dispatching the `ui/**` remainder from the lane that holds the card on its queue needs no change to the lane row, and no choice the maintainer did not make: the maintainer's own words (「写明 UI 已在 objectstack 的 `ui/` 里,剩下部分是 UI 的卡照常派」, approved with 「立卡更新skills」) pick dispatch over split-at-once, and the corrected seat then dispatched three of the seven cards that way.
- The self-split line beside it (「排队卡含他车道项 ⇒ 发现席自拆」) is where "skip" and "dispatch" could sit side by side, so the second new line draws the boundary: a `ui/**` remainder is not "another lane's item" — this seat dispatches it and does not split; self-split applies only to a card-listed, independently landable item that lands wholly in another lane's tree outside `ui/**` (spec, skills, devx, cloud keep their own routing). The lane row is untouched (it sits at 332 of its 341-byte table-row cap, with nothing to add).

**Paying the line ratchet** — every file stays at its ceiling (`SKILL.md` 319, `seat-lifecycle.md` 96, `execution-duties.md` 188), every edited line is within the 120-byte cap, and no line was re-wrapped to buy room. Five lines were deleted, each one restating a rule its main section still carries:

| Deleted line | Where the rule still lives |
|:--|:--|
| `seat-lifecycle.md` 开轮互斥 「同 session 的 subagent dev 认领不触发自退,甄别靠分支」 | reading three in the same section is defined as the newest `Claim:` *not* from this session, which already excludes a same-session dev; `execution-duties.md` 认领 「`mode:subagent` 下 dev 与 PM 同 ID,身份看分支」 |
| `seat-lifecycle.md` Epic 子树车道 「顺带发现只经立卡门:三类内缺陷才立…其余进 Acceptance notes 或座位贴」 | `SKILL.md` 报告契约 (dev files nothing; the seat files the three classes; the rest goes to Acceptance notes) and `triage-duties.md` 立卡门 |
| `seat-lifecycle.md` 断粮与跨墙恢复 「权威的墙信号是失败本身:撞墙报文里的重置时刻在那一刻可得…」 | `platform-readings.md` 断粮检测与跨墙恢复 「撞墙报文 `limit reached, resets at HH:MM`,重置时刻只此刻可得」 |
| `execution-duties.md` 候选与批次 「每轮每次唤醒首读本车道开着的 `priority:p0`,无人认领即同轮认领派发」 | `SKILL.md` 状态模型 `priority:p0` row (插队:同轮立即派发) and the 取卡前置 line above it (开放 P0/P1 每次取卡现读) |
| `execution-duties.md` 候选与批次 「该假设以机制假设身份进派发令,被证伪就在同一张卡公开更正」 | `execution-duties.md` 派发 三分区 lines (PM 机制假设须实测、鼓励证伪;⛔ 不把假设写成裁决) and `os-dev.md` 三分区义务 (证伪照实报告) |

No issue number is cited in the skill text (`pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` green). No package publishes from this diff: `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- `execution-duties.md` 认领 「部分落地…余项整树归他席 ⇒ 点名该席改标,拆分加 `pm:retriage`」 is the release-time route for a card whose remainder belongs to another seat's tree. It is not a "skip" (the card returns to `pm:queue` on this lane and is a candidate at the next refill under item 2), and the `domain:ui` seat may still relabel it, so both routes stand; it is outside this card's file surface and left as is. Noted, not filed.
- The `domain:ui` lane row and `references/lanes/ui.md` 「跨层功能的 `ui/` 子单归本席」 speak of sub-cards that triage split per layer, not of an unsplit remainder; no edit needed.
